'''Lancer Sair''' was a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who served within the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]

==Biography==
{{Quote|Right, here is the plan. You'll need to fight your way in and in the confusion find an enemy uniform. Once you have the enemy uniform, give it to the officer to make an escape.|[[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], to an Imperial spacer|<ref name="SWG:AMJ">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=faction|Imperial|Assist Mara Jade|Naboo}}</ref>}}
Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Lancer Sair was stationed in a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] facility within the [[Hidden Rebel Base|hidden Rebel base]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="SWG:RtsIO" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> the Alliance captured and imprisoned six [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|officers]] in this facility. During the [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]] festivities of the same year, [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] employed a group of loyal Imperial spacers to rescue the officers. The Imperial operatives attacked the prison facility and killed Lancer Sair during the assault. One of the Imperial spacers then took his [[Jumpsuit/Legends|jumpsuit]] so that one of the Imperial officers could sneak out of the base in the disguise.<ref name="SWG:RtsIO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lancer Sair was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RtsIO" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Lancer Sair was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 11|Game Update 11]]," published on [[June 23]], [[2009]], and was present in the game during the [[W:c:swg:Empire Day|Empire Day]] events of 2009,<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 11 Empire Day">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=940830|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 11 Empire Day}}</ref> [[2010]]<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 17 - Empire Day VII / Remembrance Day VII">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1100816|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 17 - Empire Day VII / Remembrance Day VII}}</ref> and [[2011]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Star Wars Galaxies: Hotfix 19.20">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1219548|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Hotfix 19.20}}</ref>
